original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical CUDA.jl substitutes high-level sort! for the native four-stage SDK radix pipeline. This is an algorithm/mapping difference, not evidence of a wrong sorting operator. Its single sort elapsed time is divided by repeat without repeating the sort, a separate historical S2 measurement defect. Original bytes are preserved; the named study authors the native pipeline and aligns actual repeated work.

measurement_phase.historical_S2: Single measured sort divided by repeat without repeated work; statically observed in archived historical source.
measurement_phase.current_protocol: Warmup outside five trials; average last four outer trials; each case averages three actual full sorts without resetting between internal sorts.

Parent/shared workflow spans overlap subphases and must not be added to them.
